sources.snippet: This paper presents a comprehensive literature survey on image captioning, covering research published between 2018 and 2025. It introduces a novel taxonomy to classify existing approaches into nine major categories, including attention-based models, transformer-based architectures, reinforcement learning, and Vision-Language Pretraining (VLP). sources.title: Deep Learning Approaches on Image Captioning: A Review
sources.snippet: Image captioning is a research area of immense importance, aiming to generate natural language descriptions for visual content in the form of still images.
